notes.title: Elemental Showdown - Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
[h1]The wait is almost over![/h1]
I’m thrilled to announce that Elemental Showdown will officially launch on March 10th, 2025!
Check out the release date trailer to see some of the exciting new content, including more arenas, more power-ups, and more dragons: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NXgIP69_V-0
[h2]What’s New Since the Demo?[/h2]
If you played the demo, get ready for a ton of fresh content in the full release:
[list]
[*] Dynamic Arenas: Experience new interactive levels with unique challenges and surprises.
[*] More Power-Ups: Strategize and outwit your friends with even more ways to turn the tide of battle.
[*] New Dragons: Unlock and fight with a variety of adorable new dragons.
[/list]
[h2]Wishlist Now[/h2]
Don’t forget to add Elemental Showdown to your wishlist to get a notification when the game launches. 

Thank you so much for your support throughout this journey—I can’t wait for you to experience the full game and all the exciting new content!

notes.title: Elemental Showdown Beta Announcement
notes.content:
The time has finally come! After months of development, I am thrilled to announce that the beta version of Elemental Showdown is now live and ready for you to play!

🔥 What's in the Beta? 
[list]
[*]Control the Elements: Master the art of switching between elements on the fly to outwit your opponents and secure victory.
[*]Dynamic Arenas: No less than 8 arenas each with opportunities for strategy, filled with elemental zones and power-ups for you to outsmart your friends
[*]Multiplayer Mayhem: Either in local or online multiplayer, invite your friends for intense, fast-paced battles and see who among you is the true Elemental Champion!
[*]Customization: Fight with style and customize your dragon the way you want, from skin to eyes to elemental color, you decide how you fight!
[/list]
💡 How to Join the Beta:
You should have received a Beta key with instructions by mail on how to participate to the beta if you joined the mailing list. If that is not the case don't forget to join it to receive your beta key right away! https://dashboard.mailerlite.com/forms/907799/118448599834035235/share


📣 I Need Your Feedback! Your feedback is crucial as I fine-tune the game.
If you encounter any bug don't forget to mention it in this form: https://forms.gle/kPSJoUCFLBiotqBU6
And also don't forget to take the survey when finished playing: https://forms.gle/a9kLjdN1fyNNdxnQ6


💬 Spread the Word: If you enjoy the game, don't forget to tell your friends about the beta. The more players, the better the experience will be for everyone.

Wishlist Now: If you haven't already, don't forget to add Elemental Showdown to your wishlist to stay updated on all future announcements and the official release date.

Thank you all for your incredible support. I am excited to hear what you think and can't wait to see you in the arenas!
